ruleDefinitions.name: Perl Inline Command Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of perl using the "-e"/"-E" flags. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live perl code.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\perl\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "perl\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e.*"))
